contact.heading: Send a message
contact.intro: Choose whichever is easiest for you — straight to the parish office's e-mail, or a message on WhatsApp.
contact.sentWhatsapp: WhatsApp is opening in a new tab.
contact.sentEmail: Your message has been sent. We'll get back to you soon.
contact.errorEmailInvalid: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
contact.errorWhatsappUnavailable: WhatsApp isn't available right now — please send an e-mail instead.
contact.privacyNote: We use your details only to reply to your message.

apiContact.emailUnavailable: E-mail isn't available right now. Please try WhatsApp instead.
apiContact.requiredFields: Name, e-mail and message are required.
apiContact.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiContact.invalidFields: Please check your details — the e-mail address isn't valid or a field is too long.
apiContact.rateLimited: You've sent too many messages in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes.
apiContact.confirmBody: thank you for getting in touch. Your message has reached the parish office and we will reply as soon as we can.
apiContact.confirmNoReply: This is an automated message — please do not reply to it. For any questions, use the form on our website or give us a call.

error.title: Something got stuck on our end
error.body1: The fault is on our side, not yours — the candle flickered for a moment. Trying again is usually enough.
error.body2: If it keeps happening, let the parish office know and we'll pass it on to whoever keeps this running.

notFound.title: There's no page at this address
notFound.body1: Looks like you've strayed off the path a little — it happens to the best pilgrims. The link is probably outdated, or the page has since moved.
notFound.body2: Head back to the homepage, or see what's new in the parish.
